SUMBILING Punong Barangay Barangay Poblacion, Kidapawan City, Cotabato Dear Punong Barangay Sumbiling: This has reference to your letter dated September 7, 2023 requesting guidance on whether you can temporarily hold the release of Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) shares for the 3rd quarter of calendar year 2023. Per representation, the SK in your Barangay abuses the disbursement of funds and majority of the SK Members have abandoned their offices. Hence, the lack of a quorum during sessions to transact official business and the non-submission of the required monthly reports. Thus, your subject request. At the outset, Section 20(b) of Republic Act No. 10742 or the Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Act of 2015 states that the SK shall have financial independence in its operations, disbursements of their fund, income and expenditure. Further, DBM-DILG- NYC Joint Circular No. 01-2019 provides for the automatic releasing of the SK funds, to wit: 3.2 Release of the SK Fund by the Barangay 3.2.1 The SK funds shall be automatically released by the barangay to the SK, and shall not be subject to any lien or holdback that may be imposed by the barangay for whatever purpose Failure by the barangay to release any amount of the SK fund shall be subject the erring officials to penalties under existing laws. Based on the foregoing, SK fund shall be released by the Barangay, the same shall not be withhold. Moreover, in the 2023 Seal of Good Local Governance for Barangay Revised Technical Notes, the ISt Core Governance Area is Financial Administration and Sustainability. One of the indicators for the Financial Administration and Sustainability is the release of the SK funds of the Barangay. However, Item 1.6.1.3 mentioned that if the barangay does not have SK Officials or with SK Officials but no quorum and/or No SK Bank, the means of verification shall be proof of transfer of the 10% SK fund to the trust fund of the barangay such as deposit "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

slip or Official Receipt or corresponding legal form/document issued by the city/municipal treasurer if the barangay opted that the corresponding SK fund be kept as trust fund in the custody of the CIM treasurer. Accordingly, the Barangay shall not withhold the release of the SK fund, instead, the 10% SK Fund may be transferred to the: (I) trust fund of the barangay; or (2) trust fund of the City/MunicipaIity, with a proof of transfer such as deposit slip, official receipt or legal form/document issued by the city/municipal treasurer in case of option number 2. This opinion shall be without prejudice to any contrary opinion rendered by more competent authorities and/or the courts. We hope to have assisted you on the matter. Thank you Very truly yours, By the A hority of the Secretary: I TOR R. LLAMAS ATTY.
